payments.cardHint: Payments are made online through the laboratory's gateway.

APPROVED.body: Your payment was confirmed and the order moved forward automatically.

DECLINED.title: Payment declined
DECLINED.body: The gateway declined the transaction. You can try again with another payment method.

mock.title: Test gateway
mock.subtitle: Development payment simulator: choose the outcome of the transaction.
